name: iphone-use-app
subtitle: An AI agent that uses your iPhone, from the iPhone itself.

apps.name: iphone-use-app
apps.subtitle: Let an AI model use your iPhone.
apps.localizedDescription: Type a goal and a vision model drives your iPhone: screenshot, tap, swipe, type, open apps, until it's done. No Mac at run time, no extra hardware, no jailbreak. Needs Developer Mode, a pairing file made once from a Mac, LocalDevVPN, and an OpenRouter (or OpenAI-compatible) key.

versions.localizedDescription: Haiku 5.5 is the default model. Apps are opened by name (no app list sent to the model). Tap and swipe marks on step screenshots. Use Haiku / Use Sonnet buttons and an ultrafast toggle in Settings. New starter prompt.
First release. Free Apple ID build: uses LocalDevVPN instead of the built-in VPN.
